regions.cleaned_text: RECOMENDATIONS of MYST. CITY OF GOD. 1st. The fact that enemies of the Church and of re- ligion have opposed this work more bitterly and per- sistently than any other work published, save, perhaps the Holy Bible itself, is surely a recommendation. The jansenistic and atheistic inclined members of the parisian Sorbonne have (always spossord & led) led such opposition. On the other hand it has been again and again recomennded and defended by the highest author- ities in Church and state. £ Again and again, Bishops, Cardinals, Catholic universities and even Popes have praised and recomended and defended RECOMMENDATIONS: Simplest of all, the fact that this work has met with the most persistent and bitter op- position, on the part of the enemies of the Church and religion, RECOMMENDATIONS. Simplest & first, the fact that of all publications, save perhaps the holy Bible itself, this work has met with the bitterest, most persistent op- position on part of the enemies of the Church and God. Next after the devil himself, who tried every way in his power to prevent its being written and afterward from circulating among the people, it has been, ever since its first publication, the target of jansenist and atheistic bitterness. Hence, its warmest friends and staunchest defenders have been from among the most zealous Bishops, Cardinals, Generals of orders, Catholic universities and Popes themselves; from Innocent XI and Clement XI down. So that to refer to adverse criticism, from whatever source of Ven. Mother Mary of Jesus (of Agreda), or of her writings, as favoring jansenism, is surely not far fetched Clement XI down. .... So that, to refer to adverse criticism of Ven. Mother Mary of Jesus (Agreda, Spain) , as favoring jansenism and atheism is not far fetched.
